name: oot_enemy_skull_kid
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's hostile Skull Kid in Majora's Mask: he plays his flute until he notices you, then circles you, shoots needles and backflips away. Only a sword hurts him; any other hit makes him vanish. Custom enemy oot.skull_kid (no soul, as in Ship). Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
